items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Dave Bathardy made up his band. So he came over and talked with me and asked me that I wanted to play with him. I joined here.

ctx.x: He could clap his hands loud in the back of prison. Yeah, yeah.

Well we went all through the state of Florida. And when I came back, I got a band at the Doudrop. And then a couple of years after that, Dave Bathardy made up his band. So he came over and talked with me and asked me that I wanted to play with him. I joined here. So, started off with that.

Oh, excuse me for interrupting. I was going to ask some more about this trombone player, Big Chief, Russell Moore. Russell Moore, yeah. Because I met him in New York once. I thought he came from, say, the Indian territory or something like that. Oklahoma.
